I made these assumptions so I could finish without asking you:

- **Characters:** I assumed you don't have final character designs yet, so I made them up from what the names suggest:
  - **Մտմտիկ** is the thoughtful one who wonders about things. In the prompt this is a girl.
  - **Պրպտիկ** is the hands-on explorer who digs into things. In the prompt this is a boy.

  If you already have designs, attach them as reference images and use the swap line at the end of the prompt.
- **Title text:** Image models often get Armenian letters wrong. The prompt spells the title out letter by letter, and I added a second version with no text in case the title comes out wrong. In that case, add the title in layout software instead.
- **Style:** Warm, painterly 3D-storybook look, which suits ages 4–8 and works on a poster. It isn't based on any existing studio's style.

## FINAL

**Settings (Nano Banana Pro / Gemini 3 Pro Image)**
- Aspect ratio: **4:5** (portrait)
- Resolution: **4K** for print, or 2K for drafts
- Generate 4 versions. Check the Armenian letters in each one before choosing.

**Prompt A: with title**

```
A joyful poster key visual for a children's animated series for ages 4–8, vertical 4:5 composition.

CHARACTERS: Two curious kids, about 6 years old, standing together in the lower-middle of the frame, looking up in wonder.
— Left: MTMTIK, a thoughtful girl with big round eyes, a messy bun held with a pencil, a mustard-yellow cardigan over a teal dress, one finger tapping her chin, a glowing little question mark floating above her head like a light bulb.
— Right: PRPTIK, an energetic explorer boy with tousled chestnut hair, round explorer goggles pushed up on his forehead, a red-orange overall with many pockets stuffed with a magnifying glass, a small shovel and a notebook, leaning forward and pointing up excitedly.
Both have friendly, expressive faces, rosy cheeks, slightly oversized heads, and appealing rounded proportions. Their expressions read clearly as "Why?!": open mouths, raised eyebrows, sparkling eyes.

WORLD: Above and around them, the questions come to life as a swirling spiral of wonders rising toward the sky: a smiling sun, a crescent moon, a rainbow, a snail, a paper airplane, a big leaf with a raindrop, gears, a tiny rocket, a bird, a seed sprouting, a cloud raining on one flower. Soft question-mark shapes are hidden playfully in the clouds and leaf patterns. The background is a gentle hillside with a hint of Armenian landscape: soft apricot trees in bloom and the distant twin peaks of Mount Ararat in pale lavender haze.

TITLE: At the top of the poster, large, bold, rounded, hand-lettered children's title in Armenian script, reading exactly:
«Մտմտիկ և Պրպտիկ»
(letters: Մ տ մ տ ի կ — և — Պ ր պ տ ի կ). Chunky friendly letterforms, warm cream fill with a soft orange outline and a subtle drop shadow, slightly bouncy baseline. No other text anywhere on the image.

STYLE: High-quality painterly 3D storybook illustration, soft clay-like textures, warm cinematic lighting with golden sunlight from the upper left, gentle rim light on the characters. Palette: sky blue, apricot orange, sunny yellow, teal, and soft pomegranate red; bright but not neon, high contrast between the characters and the background. Clean silhouettes, readable at thumbnail size. Plenty of clear space around the title.

AVOID: scary or sharp elements, realistic photographic children, extra limbs or fingers, distorted faces, Latin or misspelled lettering, watermarks, logos, clutter covering the characters' faces.
```

**Prompt B: no text (backup if the Armenian title comes out wrong)**

Use Prompt A, but replace the whole TITLE paragraph with:
```
TITLE AREA: Leave the top 25% of the poster as calm, soft sky with light clouds, completely empty, reserved for a title to be added later. Absolutely no text, letters, or symbols resembling writing anywhere in the image.
```

**If you have existing character designs:** attach the character sheets as reference images. Then replace each character's description in the prompt with:
`"Left: the girl from reference image 1 (Մտմտիկ); Right: the boy from reference image 2 (Պրպտիկ). Keep their faces, hair, outfits, and colors exactly as in the references."`
